name: Bank of India
about: Bank of India is an India-based bank. The Bank's segments include Treasury Operations, Wholesale Banking and Retail Banking. The Treasury operations segment includes the entire investment portfolio, which is dealing in government and other securities, money market operations and foreign exchange operations.(Source : Company Web-site )
key_points: Market Position [1] The bank ranks as the sixth-largest nationalized bank in India, with advances of Rs 6.96 lakh Cr and a total business (Advances + Deposits) of Rs 15.49 lakh Cr as of Q3 FY25.

profile.summary: Bank of India provides various banking products and services in India and internationally. It operates through Treasury; Wholesale Banking; and Retail Banking segments. The company accepts various deposit products, such as savings, salary, current, term, and rera account deposits. It also provides debit, credit, and prepaid cards; personal, home, vehicle, education, star reverse mortgage, and home loans, as well as loans against property; and finance to new and existing business, healthcare schemes, government sponsored schemes, and commercial vehicle finance services. In addition, the company offers credit, cash management, and trade finance services; government deposit schemes, including public provident fund, senior citizens savings, Sukanya Samridhi, national pension system, departmentalized ministries, sovereign and RBI bond, mahila samman savings certificate, and other schemes; mutual funds; and life, health, and general insurance products. Further, it provides NRI services, such as accounts, loans, and money remittance and ancillary services; kisan credit card; gold loans; self-help group; Atmanirbhar schemes; tractor/farm mechanization; food and agro loans; agri allied activities; kisan ghar and agri mortgage loan; agri clinic/agri business centers; and other loans services. Additionally, it offers internet banking, mobile banking, and payment services. The company was incorporated in 1906 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
